description: Reg. § 1.199A-3(b)(2)(ii)(A) excludes only capital gain and loss from QBI, so § 1245 recapture of a qualified business's equipment is QBI. Wages $100,000, nonpassive K-1 income $50,000, equipment recapture $10,000: QBI $60,000 → 20% = $12,000, under 20% of taxable income (160,000 − 15,750 = 144,250 → 28,850).
